canonicalDatePolicy.rule: Use the official league/team completion or approval date when an official source exists.
canonicalDatePolicy.reportedOrAgreementDate: Preserve separately as source metadata; do not replace the canonical date.
canonicalDatePolicy.draftRightsTrades: Use the official completion announcement date.

resolutions.resolution: Official NBA records classify this as one four-team trade completed on February 6, 2025, involving Washington, Milwaukee, New York and San Antonio. The reported framework emerged February 5, but the canonical completion date is February 6.

The NBA's official 2023 offseason tracker models the Beal transaction as one three-team trade involving Phoenix and Indiana, with Bilal Coulibaly routed to Washington and Jarace Walker plus future second-round value routed to Indiana.
Washington's official completion announcement is dated June 28, 2023. Draft-night intent may be retained as agreement metadata, but the canonical transaction date is June 28.
Official Hawks, Wizards and NBA records date the Trae Young transaction January 9, 2026. The prior January 11 note was not supported by the official releases.

The official NBA trade tracker and all three team releases classify this as a three-team trade. Charlotte received Malaki Branham; Dallas received the remaining Washington package plus Tyus Jones from Charlotte.
The Ayton framework was reported July 6, but the deal became official July 7, 2026. July 7 remains the canonical date and preserves the exact Lakers perspective match.
